name: webmacro
description: Load DuckDB SQL macros (scalar and table) from a remote URL. Define a macro in a Git repo, gist, or any HTTP-served file; pull it into a session with one call. The point is centralized, versioned macro distribution — one source of truth for shared SQL helpers across machines and teammates.

cta.title: Distribute SQL macros from a URL
cta.description: Install WebMacro to load DuckDB scalar and table macros straight from a Git-hosted URL — no copy-paste, one source of truth, and version control by virtue of the URL.

quickStart.title: Load a macro from a URL and use it
